data.exact_reserve_text: Net claims incurred includes prior accident year reserve strengthening totaling GBP 4.1 million (2013: GBP 0.5m release).
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 157.998m. The report records prior accident year reserve strengthening totalling GBP 4.1m (net) in 2014 (compared with a GBP 0.5m net release in 2013). No gross prior-year movement is disclosed in the Movement note, so the quantified movement available is net of reinsurance. The Managing Agent notes several large losses in 2014 but no significant catastrophe impact; the reported prior year movement is therefore a small adverse development relative to the opening reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding) - high confidence. The Movement in prior years' provision note only discloses a NET prior year strengthening (GBP 4.1m); no gross (insurance liabilities) prior year movement is shown. Per extraction rules, the NET figure has been used as a fallback and flagged. No claims development triangle or gross prior-year movement breakdown by LOB was provided.
